bibl.title: Monolog des Wiesels: Galeomyomachie SSH 1190 Col. I 30-31.
bibl.seg: Marios Skempis, Monolog des Wiesels: Galeomyomachie SSH 1190 Col. I 30-31.
bibl.note: Offers supplements for the two last lines of Galeomyomachy SSH 1190 col. i, which draw on Homeric contexts. Argues that, contrary to various models, the fragmented text stages a weasel in verbalised monologue.
